title: Hungary, 1 dollar, Amber Route

specs.Decoration: high relief, antique finish, amber insert

descriptionPlain: Description The Amber Route was an ancient trade route linking the Baltic coast with the Mediterranean region, fostering the growth of cities and the exchange of goods, cultures, and ideas. Hungary, the third coin in the series, refers to the Roman section of this route, which ran along the Danube through the lands of ancient Pannonia. The design features Emperor Hadrian and a Roman merchant, while a natural amber insert highlights the importance of the route that connected distant worlds for centuries. Discover the story of this historic road and collect all nine coins in this exceptional series.
